review_notes:
I read all 88 lines of the target file. Then I grepped the project for every use of `enorm_setIntegral_le_good_kernel`, `distanceDifferenceKernel` and `fourPairGood`, and read the three files that use them: ActualComparableShellRebin.lean, ComparableComplexRebin.lean and PositiveDistanceRebinBound.lean. I also read the statements of `original_spatial_kernel_max` and `uniform_actual_stationary_product_kernel`.

Most of the file is not a target for this rubric. `distanceDifferenceKernel_measurable` and `measurable_fourPairGood` are one-line facts. `enorm_setIntegral_le_good_kernel` is itself shared machinery: both `original_complex_kernel_max` and `angular_complex_shell_rebin` call it.

I found two blocks inside `original_complex_kernel_max` that are repeated almost verbatim in other proofs. One converts a real pointwise kernel bound into the ENNReal form. The other moves the set S ∩ fourPairGood through `fourSpatialPairEquiv` and then applies `original_spatial_kernel_max`.

Uncertainty: I could not run Lean, so none of the proposed rewrites has been compiled. In `cell_shell_positive_kernel_max`, the rewritten use relies on `D.good`/`E.good` reducing to `d.good`/`e.good`. The current proof already relies on this when it unfolds `good`, but the exact simp set may need adjusting.

findings.proposed_change:
Add this lemma to this file, next to `distanceDifferenceKernel`:

theorem enorm_le_ofReal_mul_distanceDifferenceKernel {z : ℂ} {x : Fin 4 → Plane} {H s v : ℝ} (hH : 0 ≤ H)
    (h : ‖z‖ ≤ H*(2:ℝ)^s/(1+(2:ℝ)^v*|dist (x 0) (x 1)-dist (x 2) (x 3)|)^2) :
    ‖z‖ₑ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal H*ENNReal.ofReal ((2:ℝ)^s)*distanceDifferenceKernel v x := by
  rw [← ofReal_norm]
  convert ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal h using 1
  dsimp [distanceDifferenceKernel]
  rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_mul hH, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (mul_nonneg hH (by positivity))]
  congr 1; ring

In `original_complex_kernel_max`, lines 63–71 would become `filter_upwards [hb] with x hx; exact enorm_le_ofReal_mul_distanceDifferenceKernel hH (by rw [Real.rpow_natCast]; exact hx)`. Here `hb` uses the natural-number power `(2:ℝ)^d.t`, which `Real.rpow_natCast` matches to the lemma's real power. In `uniform_actual_comparable_shell_rebin`, after the `simp only … at he` on line 99, lines 100–106 would become `exact enorm_le_ofReal_mul_distanceDifferenceKernel hH he`. That works because `he` already has the form `H*(2:ℝ)^(-(v-bdepth))/(1+(2:ℝ)^v*|…|)^2`, with `v` cast to ℝ.
findings.benefit: About seven lines of ENNReal coercion work in each proof become one call to a named lemma. The lemma states the exact interface between real kernel bounds and `distanceDifferenceKernel`, so readers see the intent immediately. If the kernel's definition changes (for example its exponent or normalisation), only one proof needs updating.

findings.problem: This block bounds `∫⁻ x in S ∩ fourPairGood d.good e.good, distanceDifferenceKernel d.t x ∂Measure.pi (fourCells d e)`. It pulls S back to `T := fourSpatialPairEquiv.symm ⁻¹' S`, proves the set identity with `fourSpatialPairEquiv ⁻¹' (T ∩ (d.good ×ˢ e.good))` by `ext`/`simp`, and applies `original_spatial_kernel_max` after unfolding `distanceDifferenceKernel` and `Real.rpow_natCast`. `cell_shell_positive_kernel_max` in PositiveDistanceRebinBound.lean does the same steps with S = `angularLengthShell b`: the same `T`, the same measurability proof, the same set identity (with the intersection in the other order), and the same `simpa … using original_spatial_kernel_max`. The fact both proofs actually need, the spatial kernel bound on a measurable four-point set intersected with `fourPairGood`, has no statement of its own.
findings.proposed_change:
Add this lemma to this file (it already imports PositiveDistanceOriginalSpatial):

theorem PositiveDistanceData.fourPairGood_kernel_max (d e : PositiveDistanceData) [IsFiniteMeasure d.ρ] [IsFiniteMeasure e.ρ]
    (ht : d.t = e.t) (hn : d.normalization = e.normalization) (S : Set (Fin 4 → Plane)) (hS : MeasurableSet S) :
    ENNReal.ofReal ((2:ℝ)^(-((d.t:ℝ)-d.a))) * ∫⁻ x in S ∩ fourPairGood d.good e.good, distanceDifferenceKernel d.t x ∂Measure.pi (fourCells d e) ≤
      binKernelConstant * ENNReal.ofReal (d.levelMass^4*(2:ℝ)^(-2*((d.t:ℝ)-d.a))) * max d.coincidence e.coincidence

Its proof is lines 72–78 (define `T`, prove `hT` and `he`), then `rw [he]; simpa only [distanceDifferenceKernel, Real.rpow_natCast] using original_spatial_kernel_max d e ht hn T hT`.

In `original_complex_kernel_max`, lines 72–82 would become `rw [mul_assoc] at hg; exact hg.trans (by simpa only [mul_assoc] using mul_le_mul_right (fourPairGood_kernel_max d e ht hn S hS) (ENNReal.ofReal H))`. In `cell_shell_positive_kernel_max`, after `rw [lintegral_indicator …, Measure.restrict_restrict …, inter_comm, angularFourCellMeasure_eq]`, the proof would end with `simpa only [D, E, atCells, levelMass, good] using fourPairGood_kernel_max D E ht hn _ (measurable_angularLengthShell b)`. The local `T`, `hT` and `he` would no longer be needed.
findings.benefit: The pull-back through `fourSpatialPairEquiv` and the set identity are proved once. Both kernel-max proofs then read as one step: specialise the spatial bound. Each currently re-derives a ten-line change-of-variables bridge. Any future rebinning variant can reuse the lemma, and a change to `fourPairGood` or to the statement of `original_spatial_kernel_max` needs only one fix.
